Vietoris–Rips persistence with phlite_rips

A point cloud sampled from a noisy figure eight has two loops. We compute its Vietoris–Rips barcode up to dimension 1, with representatives, draw the loops on the points, and watch the filtration grow.
299 finite H0 bars and 27 finite H1 bars (bars of length zero are omitted), computed with representatives in 34 ms.

Watching the filtration

At radius ||(r||) the Vietoris–Rips complex has an edge between every two points at distance at most ||(r||) (and a simplex on every set of points that are pairwise that close; only the edges are drawn). Components merge quickly; each lobe of the figure eight closes into a loop, which is filled in once the points across it are within ||(r||) of each other. On the right, the bars alive at ||(r||) are highlighted.
